roomReconciliation.reviewQuestion: Is the supported finite pair fair for this ordinary three-room count, without a consequential ordinary-answer false negative? U1 is not closed merely because the model changed or source bytes match.

No consequential ordinary-answer false negative established. High confidence in model/pair; moderate confidence in finite-scope adjudication, not an exhaustive dialect judgment. Voiced alternatives remain unverified.

sources.observed: A lapse since the previous occurrence; time noun + ぶりに and noun-modifying ぶりの. Short intervals can sound unusual but are not categorically incorrect.
N3 teaching entry for ぶりだ/ぶりに/ぶりの. Time passes before recurrence; even short intervals can be used when experienced as long.
Actual N3 heading and duration + ぶり examples distinguishing a gap before repetition.

records.contrast: Interval since the previous visit versus duration of this visit

records.construction: Time span + ぶりの + recurring weather noun
records.contrast: Gap since previous rain versus continuous duration of rain

intervalSupplement.rubricQualification: Author editorial estimates, not measured difficulty. Existing contract defines all five axes. Feedback is completeness, not difficulty.
intervalSupplement.responseContract: Exactly one external answer slot. Instructions define Arabic-digit labels for two competing interpretations without translating the Japanese report. Correct labels differ between the two tasks. Both options and full answer-side translations explain the semantic contrast.
intervalSupplement.contextAccounting: Two new interpretations, two semantic contexts and one facet. The change from a repeated intentional visit with ぶりに to recurring weather with ぶりの changes event type and attachment, not merely a noun or numeral. No free-production, mastery or general transfer claim.
intervalSupplement.gates: Append one group to the existing chapter; no new prerequisite or recommendation edges.
intervalSupplement.classificationBoundary: The separate 22 numerical interpretations remain unclassified. The two new N2 tasks are additional, not included in that count, and are excluded from N3-filtered unseen intake.

globalReconciliation.contextLimits: Do not sum packet families into a global independent-context total. Pilots, sound drills, numeral substitutions, Read projections, paired interpretations and cross-packet whole/unit or label/count reasoning overlap.
globalReconciliation.difficultyLimits: Practical intermediate breadth and selected finer decisions, not a strict item-by-item N5-to-N4-to-N3 staircase. Supported vocabulary and supplied quantities are not extra decision/calculation load. Retain the conservative calculation-2 assessment for the two transparent remainder interpretations; feedback is explanatory completeness, not difficulty. No measured transfer, proficiency or learning claim.
